QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_37

question.text: Under the Depositories Act, 1996, a depository participant is described as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the Depositories Act, 1996, a Depository Participant (DP) is described as an agent of the depository, with the relationship governed by the agreement between the DP and the depository. The Trap: The DP is neither a subsidiary, a branch, nor an independent entity for this statutory description; the source frames the DP specifically as the depository's agent. Note: Page 259 supports the agent description and the agreement-based relationship under the Depositories Act, 1996.
